shortDescription: Check or wait for migrations between nodes

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: How long to try to connect before giving up (milliseconds).

options.name: consecutive_good_checks
options.description: How many times should the cluster report "no migrations" consecutively before returning OK back to ansible?

options.name: fail_on_cluster_change
options.description: Fail if the cluster key changes if something else is changing the cluster, we may want to fail.

options.name: host
options.description: Which host do we use as seed for info connection.

options.name: local_only
options.description: Do you wish to only check for migrations on the local node before returning, or do you want all nodes in the cluster to finish before returning?

options.name: migrate_rx_key
options.description: The metric key used to determine if we have rx migrations remaining. Changeable due to backwards compatibility.

options.name: migrate_tx_key
options.description: The metric key used to determine if we have tx migrations remaining. Changeable due to backwards compatibility.

options.name: min_cluster_size
options.description: Check fails until cluster size is met or until tries is exhausted.

options.name: port
options.description: Which port to connect to Aerospike on (service port).

options.name: sleep_between_checks
options.description: How long to sleep between each check (seconds).

options.name: target_cluster_size
options.description: When all aerospike builds in the cluster are greater than version 4.3, then the C(cluster-stable) info command is used. Inside this command, you can optionally specify what the target cluster size is - but it is not necessary. You can still rely on O(min_cluster_size) if you do not want to use this option. If this option is specified on a cluster that has at least one host <4.3 then it is ignored until the min version reaches 4.3.

options.name: tries_limit
options.description: How many times do we poll before giving up and failing?
